messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Smart-routing alert - elevated error rate for 'checkout-service' after canary rollout (policy=canary-v2, fallback=sticky-region). Trigger: 5xx spikes + variant-mismatch. Pager: @kevin @maria  

maria: seeing it. console shows canary-v2 instances returning 503 intermittently and traffic is stuck to fallback nodes in us-west-2.

kevin: on it. quick question - did the canary include a model variant rename? I remember we merged variant tags last week.

raj: yep, canary-v2 was supposed to point at model-id: rdx-chat-v2-quant. config accidentally references rdx-chat-v1:tag=canary. looks like routing accepted it because variant compatibility rule matched loosely -> ended up sending requests to old runtime variant which fails under seq_len=2048.

lina: that mismatch explains the 503s. fallback policy is sticky-region with TTL 3600s, so once a client hits the fallback it's pinned -> causing region fallback loop when capacity in fallback becomes saturated. customer traffic keeps failing back and then re-routing.

maria: immediate mitigation plan: 1) Pause canary rollout 2) Evict sticky sessions for affected tenant(s) 3) Force routing to stable variant 4) Notify support & customers. Anyone disagree?

kevin: +1. pausing now. @deploy-bot pause rollout canary-v2 --env prod

deploy-bot: command accepted. Rollout 'canary-v2' pause initiated by kevin at 2024-11-12T15:21:11Z.

raj: trying eviction: running `redwoodctl routing evict --tenant checkout-service --policy sticky-region --region us-west-2 --reason "canary variant mismatch"`

```
$ redwoodctl routing evict --tenant checkout-service --policy sticky-region --region us-west-2 --reason "canary variant mismatch"
Evicting 124 sticky sessions... done
Forcing route refresh to control plane... ok
Affected backends set to stable: rdx-chat-v1
```

maria: after eviction, I'm seeing traffic rebalanced to us-east-1 stable nodes. 5xxs dropping, latency normalizing.

kevin: good. but we saw a burst of customer errors for a ~7m window. we've got two tier-1 customers reporting checkout failures. raising incident severity to P1 and looping in support.

lina: collecting impact: 2 customers, roughly ~1.2k requests failed, peak error rate 12% for checkout endpoints. No data exfil or integrity issues observed.

sre-pager: paging oncall to monitor fallback capacity and ensure no oscillation. recommend lowering sticky TTL from 3600 -> 60 for now.

maria: changing TTL: `redwoodctl routing update-policy --name sticky-region --set ttl=60 --env prod`

```
$ redwoodctl routing update-policy --name sticky-region --set ttl=60 --env prod
Policy sticky-region updated: ttl 3600 -> 60
Broadcasting policy change... ok
```

raj: also updating model catalog entry to correct variant tag to prevent re-rollout: `catalog patch model rdx-chat-v2 --variant-tag canary` and creating a validation check in CI for variant names.

kevin: notifying support + customers. @support-team please send a status update to the two affected accounts: apologetic, mention we've mitigated, root cause is variant tag mismatch during canary, and we paused rollout. ETA for full resolution: 2h for audit and roll forward.

maria: handing off to night oncall @kevin. I'll attach logs and commands executed in the handoff doc. Kevin, you own follow-up (postmortem + CI check)

kevin: taking over. summary for next shift: initial cause: canary variant tag mispointed to older model leading to runtime failures under long contexts -> sticky-region fallback had long TTL causing capacity saturation -> eviction + TTL reduce + pause rollout mitigated. Customer impact: two accounts affected, ~1.2k failed requests, brief 7m window. Action items: 1) postmortem 2) CI validation for variant tags 3) consider auto-eviction policy for sticky fallback when backend errors >5% 4) update runbook.

maria: thanks. opening incident ticket  INC-2024-215 for tracking and postmortem. tagging @oncall-manager for SLA follow-up.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2024-215 created by maria. Severity: P1 -> Pager cleared. Next update expected within 60m. :white_check_mark: 

kevin: will follow up with a short customer-facing summary in #customer-success and schedule postmortem review tomorrow. leaving note: no rollback required, just fix tag + safe rollout after CI. taking the channel.

sre-pager: monitoring continues. set alert to watch fallback queue depth and canary error-rate for 12h.

maria: thanks team. postmortem/ownership assigned to raj (root cause and fix) and kevin (communications + runbook).

kevin: filing handoff: taking 1h watch then hand to night SRE. if it spikes back to >3% 5xx we re-pager.

lina: adding runbook note: when canary fails + sticky fallback, immediate steps = pause rollout -> evict sticky -> set TTL 60 -> validate model tags -> lift pause after verification.

kevin: end of channel update. :thumbsup:
